title: fix(i18n): the ru tab badge and reaction chip and the ar tab badge and comment thread read right at every count (objectui#10242)
body:
Fixes #10242
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

The tab-count badge's accessible name, the activity-feed reaction chip and the comment thread each pick their `…One` key at exactly one and the plain key at every other count. On the five values this card names, the plain key held a single noun form, which is wrong at some of the counts it serves: `ru` at 2-4 (`few`) and 21 (`one`), `ar` at 2 (`two`) and from 11 up (`many`, `other`).

In this body the i18next placeholders are spelled COUNT and EMOJI; the tree uses the double-brace form.

The pin reproduced the defect before any value changed: `Tests 15 failed | 15 passed (30)`. The received strings were the shipped ones: `2 элементов`, `21 элементов`, `👍 2 реакций`, `2 عناصر`, `11 عناصر`, and a thread header `2 تعليقات` with tooltip `2 تفاعلات`.

## The change: the objectui#10024 device, key by key

The count-not-one half of the five values named on the card becomes a count label: a label, a colon, then the number, so no noun has to agree with it.

| key | pack | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `common.itemCount` | ru | `COUNT элементов` | `Элементов: COUNT` |
| `detail.reactionCount` | ru | `EMOJI COUNT реакций` | `EMOJI Реакций: COUNT` |
| `common.itemCount` | ar | `COUNT عناصر` | `عدد العناصر: COUNT` |
| `collaboration.commentCount` | ar | `COUNT تعليقات` | `عدد التعليقات: COUNT` |
| `collaboration.reactionCount` | ar | `COUNT تفاعلات` | `عدد التفاعلات: COUNT` |

- `ru` matches the controls that already read right on the same two-key convention, `collaboration.commentCount` (`Комментариев: COUNT`) and `collaboration.reactionCount` (`Реакций: COUNT`), and `detail.repeaterItemCount` (`Элементов: COUNT`).
- `ar` uses the `عدد …: COUNT` shape of `search.resultsCountPlural` (objectui#10240), `calendar.a11y.dayCell` and `ai.formAssist.suggestionCount`. عدد ("number of") heads a fixed phrase with the definite plural, and the number follows the colon as a value, so the dual, 3-10, 11-99 and 100+ rules never apply.
- So `ru` now reads right on the badge and the reaction chip, and `ar` on the badge and the comment thread. The `ru` comment thread already did. `ar` `detail.reactionCount` (the Arabic reaction chip) is not in this card's key list and is unchanged; see Acceptance notes.
- The singular halves, the key set, the call sites and the other eight packs are unchanged. ⛔ No `_few` / `_two` key: `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` holds every pack to `en`'s key set.
- `.changeset/10242-ru-ar-count-labels.md` declares a patch for `@object-ui/i18n`.

## File surface: one file widened by the seat

The claim (comment 5822573875) named `ru.ts`, `ar.ts`, one pin and one changeset. The seat's amendment (comment 5824097794) added `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/marketplace-preview-namespace-3546.test.tsx`, for its premise assertion only.

That assertion required eight packs' `common.itemCount` to be COUNT, a space, then the unit noun, which pinned exactly the `ru` and `ar` values this card corrects. It is re-derived, not loosened: the other six packs keep the exact premise, and `ru` and `ar` expect their count label. The phrase checks on `preview.history.items` below it are untouched.

## Pin

`packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/countLabels.ruAr-10242.test.tsx`, beside the objectui#10024 pin and in the same shape:

- It uses a real i18next instance from `createI18n`, with the booted language asserted, and `t` is not mocked.
- It renders each consumer for real (the reaction chip in `en` and `ru` only, since `ar` `detail.reactionCount` is outside the card). `app-shell` is the one package that depends on all three: `page:tabs` from `@object-ui/components`, `ReactionPicker` from `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, and `CommentThread` from `@object-ui/collaboration`. The reaction chip passes `count` as a number, so i18next's own plural lookup is in the path.
- It covers the triage's representative counts, `ru` 2, 5 and 21 and `ar` 2, 3 and 11, plus 1 for the untouched singular half. `en` and the `ru` comment thread are controls.
- It names the shipped-defect strings and reads the `Intl.PluralRules` categories.
- It asserts the mechanism on the pack values: the count-not-one half ends in a colon then COUNT, and differs from its `One` half.

## Evidence

The code evidence is at `6aa965ae7`. HEAD `f0645e02a` changes only the changeset's prose: its opening sentence no longer claims Arabic on the reaction chip. At `f0645e02a`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `-fixed`, `-overwrite`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes` and `check:new-line-citations` all exit 0.


- **Fix:** the pin alone reads `Tests 30 passed (30)`.
- **Ablation:** it ran on the committed fix `bac9cd4c5`, which carries the values and the pin; the later commit changes only the marketplace premise. It used objectstack's `ablation-replace.mjs`, one nested leg per value, and every leg reported the mutation landed. Result: `Tests 15 failed | 15 passed (30)`, identical to the reproduction. Every leg reported `ok restored: blob == HEAD`, an outer hash proof matched both packs to HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- **Affected tests:** `pnpm exec vitest run` from the repo root read `Test Files 83 passed (83)`, `Tests 1493 passed (1493)`. The set was:
  - `packages/i18n/` (including `all-locales-key-parity` and the marketplace suite);
  - the new pin, and the 10024, 9664 and 9266 pins;
  - `defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack`, `page-tabs-count-badge-i18n`, `ReactionPicker.a11yNames`;
  - `comment-thread-i18n`, `comment-thread-no-provider-fallback`, `presence-avatars-i18n`;
  - `LocationField.residueI18n-6888`, `SettingsView.i18n-4024`, and `scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-dead-keys.test.ts`.
- **Against current `main`:** `main` moved after this branch was cut. It changed none of the touched files, but it did change `packages/i18n/src/provider.tsx` (objectui#10382), so this branch's diff was also applied to `a70719765` in a throwaway tree. `packages/i18n/` plus the pin and the consumer suites read `Test Files 76 passed (76)`, `Tests 1257 passed (1257)`.
- **Gates, all exit 0:**
  - `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` ("No en value changed in this range") and `check:i18n-dead-keys`;
  - `check:control-bytes`, and `check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)");
  - `check-changeset-presence`, `-no-major`, `-fixed` and `-overwrite` ("1 changeset(s) added, 0 modified, 0 deleted");
  - `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-test-path-roots` and `check-vi-mock-override-shape`.
- **Type-check:**
  - `@object-ui/i18n` exits 0 at `6aa965ae7`, after building its dependency closure.
  - `@object-ui/app-shell` exited 0 at `bac9cd4c5`, after `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...` ran 28 of 28 tasks. The later commit does not touch `app-shell`. `tsc -p packages/app-shell/tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new pin.
- **Lint:** it covered the four touched code files only, with 0 errors and 0 warnings. `eslint --print-config` shows no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so no type-aware linting runs, and this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict. The full `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` runs are CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **Same defect, outside this card's key list; filed by the seat at acceptance as objectui#10425.** This is seven keys and eight values. Each sits behind a verified `=== 1` two-key switch, and none is changed here:
  - `ar` `detail.reactionCount` (ReactionPicker);
  - `ar` `collaboration.presentUserCount` and `collaboration.moreUserCount` (PresenceAvatars);
  - `ru` and `ar` `list.recordCount` (ListView);
  - `ar` `lookup.recordCount` (RecordPickerDialog);
  - `ar` `detail.revisionFieldsChanged` (PointInTimeRestore);
  - `ar` `search.itemsAvailable` (SearchResultsPage). Its value is also pinned in `searchItemsAvailable-plural-9664.test.ts`.
- **Arabic wording.** The author is not a native speaker. The wording keeps to the precedent's device, `عدد` plus the definite plural. objectui#9266 used a bare definite label (`العناصر: COUNT`) for `preview.history.items`; the dispatch asked for the objectui#10240 form.
- **Singular halves.** They are left as they were, and they are correct at exactly one.

## Review-tier question

The closing sentence of `.changeset/9664-search-items-available-plural.md` says `ar` `search.itemsAvailable` "now uses the same noun pair that `ar`'s `common.itemCount`/`itemCountOne` already uses". After this PR, `ar` `common.itemCount` carries that noun only as `العناصر`, inside a count label. The sentence is loosened, not falsified, because the lemma pair عنصر / عناصر is unchanged. It is left unedited because it is outside this card's surface. Does the review tier want it reworded before release?
